profile.name: Shreya G K
profile.headline: Software Engineer · AI Systems · Test Automation
profile.value_prop: I build Python systems where AI answers stay grounded in sources, APIs stay predictable, and automated tests give changes a safety net.
profile.summary: Graduate Engineer Trainee at HCLTech, Bengaluru, with project work across multi-agent AI evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation, transactional backends and Selenium-based test automation.

claims.title: Grounded AI answers
claims.text: Query planning, dense retrieval with cross-encoder reranking, a corrective loop that grades context sufficiency, and abstention when grounding is weak.

claims.title: Reliable APIs
claims.text: Idempotent checkout APIs and HMAC-signed webhooks in Ticket Ledger; JWT auth, role-based access and idempotent Stripe webhooks in SlotSync.

claims.title: Resilient automation
claims.text: A hybrid Selenium framework with Page Object Model, BDD, API and database checks and parallel Selenium Grid runs, plus a scraper that retries with backoff and repairs broken selectors.

claims.title: Database consistency
claims.text: Row-level locking and double-entry ledger entries in Ticket Ledger; exclusion constraints and Row-Level Security in SlotSync.

claims.title: Regression confidence
claims.text: Mutation testing to measure suite effectiveness, and a flaky-test detector that reruns tests and quarantines unstable ones.

projects.title: Adversarial Multi-Agent Red-Team System
projects.short: Multi-agent platform that stress-tests AI agents and scores their robustness.
projects.approach: A multi-agent robustness-testing platform that automatically stress-tests AI agents. A challenger agent generates probing test cases across configurable categories, and a judge agent scores each response with a severity rating.
decisions: Automated before/after regression suite that quantifies robustness gains after hardening, producing per-category vulnerability scores and structured mitigation reports
Every run instrumented with step-level tracing of token cost, latency, and failure modes
Full run history persisted to a SQL database and surfaced through a Streamlit dashboard
projects.evidence: Live hosted demo. Project repository URL not supplied, so no repository button is shown.
projects.art_alt: Illustration: a challenger agent sends probe questions to a judge agent, which scores responses in a severity grid.

projects.title: Intelligent Web Scraping & Monitoring System
projects.short: Automated web monitoring with multi-strategy scraping and self-healing selectors.
projects.approach: An automated monitoring platform with multi-strategy scraping that escalates from a static fetch to a Selenium browser only when JavaScript rendering is required, then extracts schema-validated structured data from messy HTML.
decisions: Escalation from static fetch to a Selenium browser only when JavaScript rendering is required
Schema-validated structured data extracted from messy HTML
Self-healing selectors that detect and repair broken extractors when a site's layout changes
Fault-tolerant scheduled scraping with retries, exponential backoff, and automatic skipping of failing targets
Semantic change detection with smart alerting through a Streamlit dashboard
projects.evidence: Live hosted demo. No impact metrics or results were supplied, so none are shown. Project repository URL not supplied, so no repository button is shown.
projects.art_alt: Illustration: layered browser windows, extracted data cards sliding out, and a page-changed alert.

projects.title: Production Agentic RAG System
projects.short: Agentic RAG with query planning, reranking, a corrective loop and abstention.
projects.approach: An agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation system, built and deployed, with query planning that decomposes multi-part questions into sub-queries and synthesizes combined, source-cited answers.
decisions: Dense vector retrieval in ChromaDB with cross-encoder reranking (a single retrieval method, so not described as hybrid)
A corrective retrieval loop that grades context sufficiency before answering
Grounding-score-based abstention to reduce unsupported answers
Automated evaluation harness using RAGAS faithfulness, answer relevancy, context precision and context recall, integrated into continuous integration
Semantic caching, and Langfuse tracing of cost and latency
projects.evidence: Live hosted demo. No evaluation scores or numerical improvements were supplied, so none are shown, and the demo is not an independent verification of production readiness. Project repository URL not supplied, so no repository button is shown.

projects.title: Ticket Ledger
projects.short: Flash-sale ticketing platform with a double-entry ledger.
projects.approach: A flash-sale ticketing platform where purchases, holds, and refunds post balanced entries to a double-entry ledger.
decisions: Atomic inventory reservation using PostgreSQL row-level locking and Redis
Time-limited ticket holds automatically released by Celery background workers
Idempotent checkout REST APIs using idempotency keys
HMAC-signed payment webhooks with exponential-backoff retries
Automated reconciliation job that verifies ledger integrity
projects.evidence: Described on the resume only; no demo or repository supplied. The load-test result is the resume's claim and is not independently verified. A throughput number was not supplied, so none is shown.
reported: Zero oversold tickets under the tested load, while a naive baseline oversold tickets under identical load.
projects.art_alt: Illustration: a ticket with a hold countdown above balanced debit and credit ledger columns.

projects.title: SlotSync
projects.short: Multi-tenant appointment booking SaaS for clinics and salons.
projects.approach: A multi-tenant SaaS web application in Django and DRF for clinics and salons to manage services, staff, and bookings, with tenant data isolation enforced by PostgreSQL Row-Level Security.
decisions: JWT authentication and role-based access control for owner, staff, and customer roles
Timezone-aware slot scheduling
Double-bookings prevented at the database level with PostgreSQL exclusion constraints, verified by concurrent-request tests
Stripe subscription billing in test mode with idempotent webhooks, Celery-driven email reminders, and audit logging
Shipped with pytest suites and GitHub Actions CI
projects.evidence: Described on the resume only; no demo or repository supplied.

projects.title: End-to-End QA & Hybrid Test Automation Framework
projects.short: Full STLC and hybrid automation framework for a self-hosted OrangeHRM.
projects.approach: The full STLC executed on a self-hosted OrangeHRM application, from test plan and manual cases to a hybrid automation framework with nightly pipelines.
decisions: Authored a test plan, manual test cases using boundary value analysis and equivalence partitioning, and a requirements traceability matrix
Logged defects in Jira with severity, priority, and steps to reproduce
Hybrid framework using Page Object Model, data-driven testing with Apache POI, and Cucumber BDD for UI regression scenarios
REST Assured API tests and JDBC database validation to confirm UI actions persisted correctly
Cross-browser tests run in parallel on a Dockerized Selenium Grid
Nightly Jenkins and GitHub Actions pipelines publishing Allure reports with failure screenshots

projects.title: TestLab
projects.short: Mutation-testing harness and flaky-test detector for a Selenium suite.
projects.approach: A mutation-testing harness that injects controlled defects into a Dockerized web application, plus a flaky-test detector, used to judge how effective a Selenium regression suite is.
decisions: Injected defects include removed elements, broken validations, wrong calculations, and delayed loads
Mutation score defined as the share of injected defects detected by the Selenium regression suite
Flaky-test detector reruns each test five times in parallel
Root causes classified into synchronization, locator, test data, and environment
Unstable tests automatically quarantined from the CI quality gate
